name: Candlemas Blessing
text: Every hero and Vigil Candle starts the Night with Ward.
flavor: The bells of Candlemas ring out, and every flame stands a little taller.

name: Lucky Wick
text: Draw up to 6 cards instead of 5.
flavor: A wick that burns crooked burns lucky, or so the chandlers swear.

name: Hearthwind
text: At every Tally, every Wickfolk piece heals 1 HP.
flavor: A warm wind from the hearths of home, carrying the smell of fresh wax.

name: Peddler of Wicks
text: +1 Flame at the start of every seat turn.
flavor: Wicks, fine wicks! Two for a copper, three for a kind word!

name: Moth Migration
text: Each hero starts the Night with a free Velvet Moth (placed next to the hero; counts toward the unit limit).
flavor: The moths come home to the Vigil, as they do once every hundred nights.

name: Soot Fog
text: Every Wickfolk range (strikes, cards, Powers) is 1 shorter, minimum 1.
flavor: A yellow fog creeps up from the gutters. You can scarcely see your own wick.

name: Bell of Embers
flavor: The great bell rings red, and the Snuff's touch now burns.

name: Waxen Rain
text: At every Plume placement, 2 Hot Wax pools also appear on empty flagstones at least 2 from every hero.
flavor: Hot wax falls from the high chandeliers like a slow, cruel rain.

name: Ill Omen
text: Moth Die faces 5 and 6 count as 3 (Stillness).
flavor: The Moth-Moon is veiled tonight. Do not trust your luck.

name: Crumbling Nave
text: At Night start, every Pillar crumbles into Rubble, and 4 more Rubble tiles appear on empty flagstones.
flavor: The old stones groan. Pillars that stood a thousand years give way.

name: Restless Soot
text: Snuff steps and slides move 1 tile farther.
flavor: The Snuff are restless tonight, and they hurry.

name: Shifting Chimneys
text: At every Tally, each Chimney pair moves to new empty flagstones at least 2 from every hero.
flavor: The chimneys wander in the night, as chimneys sometimes do in Sconcewick.

name: Muffled Nave
text: Each seat may play at most 2 cards per seat turn.
flavor: A velvet hush lies on the nave. Even the cards whisper.

name: Black Sun
flavor: A black sun hangs over the spires, and the smoke pours thicker.
